notes: Partition verified: 14 source / 21 target, each used once across 15 units.
The substantival article takes *one that* and heads on the pronoun (rule 41); italic *this* is `added`.

The correlative frame *As is ... so is* is split, with the first copula on כְּ (rule 49) and *so is* on בִּתָּהּ. Rules 20 and 49 would put both copulas on the prepositional predicate and leave the subject only *daughter*; the note records that competing reading.
